query: Develop secure enterprise services with persistent data storage, access controls, business workflows and containerized deployment.
Build an end-to-end web application covering browser-based user interfaces, server-side APIs, relational storage and user login.
Evaluate unreliable AI-generated outputs, detect invalid results and systematically analyze model failure modes.
Adapt a pretrained model to specialized noisy data while measuring prediction quality and investigating unstable generation behavior.
Use surrogate models to reduce the number of expensive experimental evaluations required when searching a parameter space.
Develop engineering software that allows researchers to interactively inspect, filter, visualize and export numerical measurements.
Design automated quality gates for generated technical artifacts and reject outputs that are syntactically valid but semantically ineffective.
Investigate a machine learning system whose outputs degrade after adaptation and identify the cause through controlled experiments.
Implement authorization, user-specific data visibility and controlled state transitions in a database-backed business application.
Analyze computational experiments in Python and communicate algorithm behavior through quantitative plots and convergence analysis.
